text: The dataset that shows there was forest on the property in 2020 is the "Global Forest Change" dataset, version "GFC-2025-v1.13" provided by the University of Maryland (Hansen/UMD). This dataset was used to observe tree cover in 2000 and recorded tree-cover loss events up until 2020. Although the JRC GFC2020 V4 dataset did not observe forest in 2020, the Hansen GFC dataset is sufficient to corroborate the presence of forest on the property in that year.
